summary.en: GLM 5 and GLM 4 support thinking-mode playback below the picker.
summary.zh: GLM 5 与 GLM 4 已在选择器下层适配 thinking-mode 回放。

title.en: GLM thinking-mode is wired into the chat gateway.
title.zh: GLM thinking-mode 已接入聊天网关。

description.en: `glm-5` and `glm-4` use `reasoning_content` playback through the OpenAI Chat Completions channel. Neither is exposed in the main picker.
description.zh: `glm-5` 与 `glm-4` 通过 OpenAI Chat Completions 通道适配 `reasoning_content` 回放，当前均未在主选择器露出。

title.zh: 两个已完成适配的 GLM Model ID。

description.en: The adapter supports thinking-mode and the chat gateway.
description.zh: 适配器支持 thinking-mode 与聊天网关。

question.zh: 已配置哪些 GLM 版本？

answer.en: `glm-5` and `glm-4`; neither is exposed in the main picker.
answer.zh: `glm-5` 与 `glm-4`，两者当前均未在主选择器露出。

title.en: GLM protocol support is ready below the picker.
title.zh: GLM 协议支持已在选择器下层就绪。

description.en: The page reflects adapter readiness without claiming client-picker availability.
